facts.fact: The World Bank technical note says the SPRINT module built to import data from external sources had never been used, and that Sierra Leone had no Data Protection Act, so data sharing between agencies carried unmitigated risk.
facts.system: Social Protection Registry for Integrated National Targeting (SPRINT)

facts.fact: The World Bank technical note says the initial SPRINT configuration would upload existing beneficiary and applicant data from current and former programmes, and that a data sharing policy would be developed for exchanges with external entities.
